title: Super Pi keybindings
description: Editor assistance for ~/.sp/agent/config/keybindings.json (or <agentDir>/config/keybindings.json). All actions are optional. Omit an action to keep its defaults; use [] to unbind it. Only global keybindings are loaded. This schema checks built-in action names and value types, not key syntax, conflicts or terminal support.

$schema.description: Editor schema URL or local file reference.

key.description: Key notation, for example ctrl+x, shift+ctrl+p, escape, pageUp or a single character. Modifiers include ctrl, shift, alt and super. Matching is case-insensitive and accepts esc/return aliases. String syntax and terminal support are not validated here.

binding.description: One key or an array of alternatives replaces the action defaults. An empty array disables the action. Omit the action to retain defaults; inspect /hotkeys for the current platform and effective configuration.
